title: Notice to Rescind NOT-MH-22-310, Notice of Information on NIMH Policy Updates for Career Development Programs (K awards)
purpose_tldr: Rescinds NOT-MH-22-310, NIMH's prior Notice of Information on policy updates for Career Development (K) award programs. The rescission is effective immediately; the 2022 policy guidance no longer applies.
eligibility_tldr: Affects K-award applicants and current K awardees at NIMH who were relying on the rescinded policy. Refer to general NIH K-award guidance and any successor NIMH notices for current policy.
dos: Stop citing or relying on NOT-MH-22-310 in proposals and progress reports
Check the NIMH Office of Research Training and Career Development page for current guidance
Notify mentors and grants administration if NOT-MH-22-310 was referenced in pending applications
donts: Do not assume the rescinded guidance still applies even for in-flight applications
Do not delay updating any institutional documents that quote NOT-MH-22-310
